heading: Tuesday, February 3, 2026
topLine: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Coder-Next open-weight coding model.

items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3-Coder-Next open-weight coding model
items.summary: Qwen3-Coder-Next is an Apache-2.0 open-weight MoE model (80B total, 3B active) for coding agents and local development, with 256K context. Qwen reports 70.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 44.3 on SWE-bench Pro.
